vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2108 (TS-native semantic transforms + detectLegacyVbriefLayout); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: TS-native semantic transforms and legacy-layout detector

narratives.Description: Implement the idempotent in-document transforms that convert a v0.6 artifact to v0.8 and the detector that recognizes a legacy layout. This story is independently buildable as a self-contained migration module with unit tests, separate from the repo-wide rename and the consumer CLI surface.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add a packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate module with a transform function (vBRIEFInfo->xBRIEFInfo, version 0.6->0.8, x-vbrief/->x-xbrief/, embedded path rewrites) plus the two locked safety rules, and a detect function mirroring precutover. 2. Write vitest tests that assert idempotency, transactional rollback, the version-gated feature-emission rule, and that a write into a legacy tree does not create a split layout; verify with targeted test runs.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want a tested transform-and-detect module, so that artifacts migrate to v0.8 idempotently without producing a split or downgrade-breaking tree.

items.title: Given a v0.6 artifact, when transformed, then it becomes valid v0.8 and rerun is a no-op

narrative.Acceptance: Given a v0.6 artifact, when the transform runs twice, then the first run produces valid v0.8 and the second run makes no further changes.

items.title: Given a version 0.6 file, when emitting, then v0.8-only constructs are rejected

narrative.Acceptance: Given a file still declaring version 0.6, when feature emission is attempted, then the module rejects writing status auto, xBRIEFInfo, or container types into it.

items.title: Given a legacy vbrief tree, when writing, then no split xbrief sibling is created

narrative.Acceptance: Given a project with a legacy vbrief layout, when a write occurs, then the detector reports the layout and the writer never creates an xbrief sibling tree.

expected_outputs: xbrief-migrate module with idempotent transforms, detector, and passing unit tests

references.title: Issue #2108: feat(vbrief): TS-native semantic transforms + detectLegacyVbriefLayout
